problem_description: Use-after-free in kcorp_nci_unregister_device(): ndev->cmd_wq is destroyed via destroy_workqueue() before kcorp_rfkill_unregister(ndev->rfk) runs, whose synchronous set_block callback invokes kcorp_nci_close_device() and queues close_work onto the destroyed cmd_wq.

Use-after-free in kcorp_dmem_unregister_region(): dmem pools on region->pools are unconditionally freed with kfree(pool) even while active_charges > 0, so outstanding kcorp_dmem_charge_handle holders later dereference freed pool memory in kcorp_dmem_uncharge_pool().
Use-after-free in kcorp_xe_pci_check_bound(): pdev->slot_name and pdev->bdf are dereferenced in kcorp_pci_dbg_emit() after kcorp_pci_dev_put(pdev) has already dropped the reference and freed pdev.

Use-after-free in kcorp_bond_enslave_port(): new_slave is appended to bond->slaves[bond->slave_cnt++] before slave_dev->ndo_open() is called, and when ndo_open() fails new_slave is kfree()d without removing it from bond->slaves[], leaving a dangling pointer used by kcorp_bond_xmit_roundrobin().
Use-after-free in kcorp_gpio_sim_item_release(): mutex_unlock(&vdev->lock) is called after kfree(vdev) has already freed the vdev structure containing lock.

Double-free of nvm in kcorp_xe_nvm_aux_init(): when kcorp_aux_device_add(&nvm->aux) fails, kcorp_aux_device_uninit(&nvm->aux) invokes kcorp_xe_nvm_aux_release() which kfree()s nvm, and the error path then calls kfree(nvm) a second time.

Double clock disable in kcorp_eth_mac_remove(): tx_clk was acquired via kcorp_devm_clk_get_enabled() which registers kcorp_devm_clk_action_cb() to disable and free tx_clk during detach, yet kcorp_eth_mac_remove() also manually calls kcorp_clk_disable_unprepare(priv->tx_clk) beforehand.

RCU use-after-free in kcorp_v9fs_kill_super(): v9ses and v9ses->aname are freed immediately via kfree() without waiting for an RCU grace period (synchronize_rcu or call_rcu_free) while concurrent RCU readers in kcorp_v9fs_vfs_get_link_rcu() still access dentry->v9ses.

Missing RCU read lock in kcorp_dmem_fold_region_stats(): traverses RCU-protected cs->stat_list via kcorp_list_next_rcu_checked() without holding rcu_read_lock() or cs->list_lock, triggering RCU warnings and racing with kcorp_dmem_remove_stat_node() reclamation.

RCU list corruption and use-after-free in kcorp_mptcp_pm_flush_addrs(): uses non-RCU kcorp_list_splice_init() on RCU-read pm->anno_list (redirecting last->next to stack-local free_list) and immediately kfree()s entries without an RCU grace period while kcorp_mptcp_pm_lookup_addr_rcu() traverses anno_list locklessly.

Use-after-free due to premature SRCU unlock in kcorp_kvm_io_bus_get_dev(): srcu_read_unlock(&vm->bus_srcu, srcu_idx) is called before returning matched kcorp_kvm_io_dev, allowing kcorp_kvm_io_bus_unregister() to finish synchronize_srcu() and kfree(target) before kcorp_kvm_dispatch_mmio_read() calls dev->read().

Hardirq deadlock in kcorp_fprop_new_period(): acquires spin_lock(&fp->lock) without disabling interrupts (spin_lock_irqsave) around kcorp_write_seqcount_begin(&fp->sequence), so if hardirq reader kcorp_fprop_hardirq_read_sum() fires on the same CPU while sequence is odd it spins forever.

Data race and NULL pointer dereference in kcorp_rk_iommu_attach_device(): iommu is added to domain->iommus and domain->iommus_lock is dropped before iommu->reg_bases is allocated and populated, allowing concurrent kcorp_rk_iommu_zap_iova() to dereference NULL iommu->reg_bases (and leaving a corrupt entry on kcalloc failure).

Race condition and list corruption in kcorp_fw_at_complete_packet(): kcorp_list_del(&t->link) modifies card->transaction_list before acquiring card->lock, racing with concurrent kcorp_fw_ar_handle_response() traversal and deletion.

NULL pointer dereference after lock drop in kcorp_kvm_nested_s2_unmap(): vm->mmu_lock is dropped and reacquired around cond_resched() inside the loop, after which vm->s2_pgt->ia_bits is dereferenced without rechecking vm->s2_pgt even though kcorp_kvm_teardown_shadow_mmu() can free vm->s2_pgt and set it to NULL meanwhile.

Missing preemption protection in kcorp_rhtab_delete_batch(): calls per-CPU accessor kcorp_this_cpu_freelist(htab) in preemptible context (alongside copy_to_user) without preempt_disable(), triggering WARN_ON(preemptible()) and racing on per-CPU freelist state upon task migration.
Sleeping in atomic context in kcorp_deferred_init_memmap_chunk(): cond_resched() is invoked inside the PFN initialization loop while holding spin_lock(&zone->init_lock).
Out-of-bounds array write in kcorp_t7xx_dpmaif_append_frag(): appends fragments to shinfo->frags[shinfo->nr_frags] without checking whether shinfo->nr_frags has reached KCORP_MAX_SKB_FRAGS.

Out-of-bounds buffer read in kcorp_ieee80211_parse_ttlm(): reads data[pos++] for link_map_presence without checking pos < elem_len (and before checking out->default_mapping, which omits the link_map_presence byte).

Out-of-bounds read in kcorp_ipq_cpufreq_probe_soc() / kcorp_ipq_cpufreq_match_list: kcorp_ipq_cpufreq_match_list[] is missing a terminating empty {} sentinel entry, causing kcorp_of_match_device_table() to read past the end of the static array when no compatible string matches.

Out-of-bounds read in kcorp_dsi_host_read_rx_fifo(): after clamping req_bytes to host->rx_map_size, ALIGN(clamped, 16) rounds burst_len back up past host->rx_map_size when rx_map_size is not a multiple of 16, reading past the end of host->rx_iomem.

Memory leak in kcorp_cifs_send_receive_cmd(): when kcorp_cifs_send_recv_wire() returns a negative error code (rc < 0), the function returns rc without freeing the 64 KiB resp_buf allocated via kzalloc().

Memory leak in kcorp_smb2_open_file_retry(): when kcorp_smb2_raw_open() returns -EAGAIN with an allocated err_buf, the retry branch sets err_buf = NULL and jumps to retry_open without calling kfree(err_buf).

Host page reference/memory leak in kcorp_kvm_user_mem_abort(): on the KCORP_ESR_FSC_EXCL_ATOMIC fault path, the function injects a guest data abort and returns 1 without calling kcorp_kvm_release_page_clean(pinned_page) to release the page acquired from kcorp_kvm_faultin_pfn().

NULL pointer dereference in kcorp_dmem_max_write(): when raw_input contains only a region name with no whitespace separator, kcorp_strsep_ws(&cursor) sets cursor to NULL, which is passed unchecked into kcorp_page_counter_memparse(cursor, &limit) and dereferenced in strcmp().

Swapped SGL arguments in kcorp_nvme_unmap_iod_sgls(): kcorp_nvme_free_sgls(dev, iod->seg_table_list, &iod->cmd_sge) passes seg_table_list as data_sge and &iod->cmd_sge as seg_list in reverse order, causing wrong DMA unmap accounting and freeing stack/inline cmd_sge instead of seg_table_list.
Use-after-free in kcorp_route_entry_replace() where old_rt is freed immediately while concurrent RCU readers in kcorp_route_lookup_gateway_rcu() may still dereference it.
Use-after-free in kcorp_bt_hci_unregister_dev() because power_wq is destroyed before kcorp_rfkill_unregister(hdev->rfk) runs its block callback.
Hardirq deadlock in kcorp_pkt_rate_advance_epoch() because interrupts remain enabled while holding est->lock and updating est->seq.
Double-free of wrap or fw_ctx in kcorp_accel_aux_probe() when kcorp_aux_device_add() fails because both kcorp_aux_device_uninit() and the error labels free wrap.
Integer multiplication overflow in kcorp_ring_register_buffers() when computing nr_iovs * sizeof(*table) or memory leak of table on copy_from_user() error.
Out-of-bounds write past shinfo->frags[KCORP_MAX_SKB_FRAGS] in kcorp_gro_append_rx_frags() when count exceeds KCORP_MAX_SKB_FRAGS.
